name: How do I choose a qualified company for water intrusion assessment?
description: Choose licensed, insured companies with experience, good reviews, and specialized tools. Ensure clear communication and a detailed report.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a qualified company for water intrusion assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a company, look for licensed and insured professionals with specific experience in water intrusion detection and remediation. Check for certifications, read client testimonials, and review their portfolio of past projects. A reputable company will offer clear communication, provide a detailed assessment plan, and offer a comprehensive report with actionable repair recommendations. Ensure they use appropriate technology for thorough investigation, such as thermal imaging or moisture mapping.
